data.name: Fuschia Satin
data.description: Our tequila cocktail: hibiscus, pineapple and lime, shaken and served up. Bright, floral and pink.
steps: Add tequila, hibiscus syrup, pineapple and lime to a shaker.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.
data.tasteLine: Bright and floral, with a little sweetness.
data.note: 20 of 45 guests who commented called it too sweet. Next: less sugar and clove, keep the acid, test a sparkling top.
data.spiritLine: Our tequila for this drink. Bright agave holds its own against the hibiscus and pineapple.
data.say: “The Fuschia Satin: tequila with hibiscus, pineapple and lime. Bright, floral and pink.”
data.story: Created for the opening menu at The Baldwin. Bar lead to add who created it, the idea behind it, and what changed after the tasting.

data.name: Cozy Blankets
data.description: Our rye cocktail: spiced pear, lemon and ginger-honey, shaken and poured over a big cube. Warm and easy.
steps: Add rye, spiced pear, lemon and ginger-honey to a shaker.
data.tasteLine: Warm, spiced and easy to drink.
data.note: Won over guests who don’t drink whiskey or like ginger. “From someone who hates ginger – I love this.”
data.spiritLine: Our rye for this drink. Its spice plays off the pear and the ginger.
data.say: “Cozy Blankets is rye with spiced pear, lemon and ginger-honey. Warm and easy, even if you don’t usually drink whiskey.”
data.story: Created for the opening menu at The Baldwin. Bar lead to add who created it, the idea behind it, and what changed after the tasting.
